# Data types in R

![Image source:https://www.javatpoint.com/r-data-types](./assets/imgs/shared/r-programming-data-types.png)


# Data structures in R

![Image source:http://venus.ifca.unican.es/Rintro/dataStruct.html](./assets/imgs/shared/dataStructures.png)

# Atomic vector
```{r}
#| label: atomic_vector_single_value
x <- 100
```

## Atomic vectors with multiple values
```{r}
#| label: atomic_vector_multiple_values
x <- c("apple", "banana", "mango")
y <- c(12, 45, 87, 90)
z <- 1:100
```

### Using variables in operations
```{r}
#| label: vector_arithmetic
y * 5

z + y
```

```{r}
#| label: vector_arithmetic_type_error
#| error: true
x + y
```


### Accessing particular values
```{r}
#| label: vector_subsetting
x[2]
y[2:3]
z[ z > 23 & z < 56]
```

# Functions
```{r}
#| label: function_round
round(pi, digits = 4)
```

# factors
```{r}
#| label: factor_levels
x <- c("low", "high", "medium", "high", "low", "medium", "high")
response <- factor(x)
response
response <- factor(x, levels = c("low", "medium", "high"))
response
```

# matrices
```{r}
#| label: matrix_create_and_subset
y <- matrix(data = 1:12, nrow = 4, ncol = 3)
dim(y)
ncol(y)
nrow(y)

y[2, 3]
y[2:3, ]
```

# Lists
```{r}
#| label: list_create
cities <- list(
    city = c("Kampala", "London", "Paris"),
    population = c(1.51, 8.8, 2.1)
)

cities
```

## Accessing list elements
```{r}
#| label: list_access_elements
cities[[2]]
cities$city
```

## Modifying the list
Modify a specific entr

```{r}
#| label: list_modify_element
cities$city[2] <- "New York"
```

Add a new element

```{r}
#| label: list_add_element
cities$country <- c("Uganda", "USA", "France")
cities
```

# Data Frames
```{r}
#| label: data_frame_create
dat <- data.frame(
    city = c("Kampala", "London", "Paris"),
    population = c(1.51, 8.8, 2.1)
)
dat
```

## Accessing records
```{r}
#| label: data_frame_access_records
dat[1:2, ]
dat$city[2]
dat[dat$population > 2, "city"]
```
